name: career-northstar-compass
description: TRX Search career reflection and decision-support skill. Helps candidates explore their professional experience, identify working preferences, prepare questions, and organize possible career directions. Candidates remain responsible for their own decisions.

interface.longDescription: Career NorthStar Compass™ by TRX Search helps experienced professionals reflect on their work, examine strengths and preferences, connect their experience into a cohesive professional story, and prepare better questions about possible career directions. Explore a career transition, an internal promotion, a sales environment, or an executive opportunity through a guided conversation. On request, NorthStar can organize your reflections into a NorthStar Map, Coaching Prep Packet, Career Decision Brief, Opportunity Fit Checklist, or portable Session Snapshot. A Quick Start Guide and an expanded Field Guide are available within the conversation upon request. This is a conversational thinking aid, not an assessment of suitability or a source of guaranteed career outcomes. ChatGPT can make mistakes; review and correct its interpretations, verify important information, and make your own decisions.
defaultPrompt: I am considering a career change. Can we talk it through?
Show me the Quick Start Guide.
Help me evaluate a possible promotion.

review.commerce_description: Free career reflection resource; no payments, subscriptions, or in-plugin purchases.

publication.release_notes: Review-focused update: removed website-hosted PDF referrals and promotional follow-ups; guides are provided within chat on request. Core reflection/coaching workflows and required developer/policy metadata remain unchanged.
